messages:
maria: Quick ask before onboarding mistral-7b-v1 — can someone run a config validation + smoke serve? weights are in s3://redwood-models/mistral/v1/weights.tar.gz but config.json uses a bare s3 path (no region) and the tokenizer has 2 added tokens that break sentencepiece load.

jonathan: I can run schema-lint on it. Reminder: our schema now requires these top-level fields: model_weights, format, tokenizer.type, tokenizer.added_tokens (array), max_sequence_length, kv_cache (true/false), quantize_bits (null|8|16), and serve.entrypoint. If any are missing lint will error.

sachin: Tokenizer quirk: the upstream export put added_tokens as a comma-separated string instead of an array (seen with sentencepiece export). Easy jq fix but it blocks tokenizer.load() at init.

katie: PR #489 fixed the canonical parsing in model-tools, but until that's in prod you can patch the config locally: 

```
jq '.tokenizer.added_tokens |= (if type=="string" then split(",") else . end)' config.json > config.fixed.json
```

avi: (typo) meant avi: Also check quantize_bits — the model header says 4 but our runtime for sm_86 doesn't support 4-bit for this architecture. Set quantize_bits to 8 or null for now.

avi\/avi: small note: the serve.entrypoint should point to the runner shim, e.g. "serve.entrypoint": "runners/mistral_v1:entrypoint" — otherwise Dedicated routing won't match.

schema-lint-bot: schema-lint results for config.json -> errors:
 - tokenizer.added_tokens: expected array, got string
 - quantize_bits: 4 not supported for runtime cuda:sm_86 (supported: 8,16,null)
 - missing field: serve.entrypoint (recommended)

maria: Thanks — I'll normalize added_tokens and set quantize_bits=8 and add the serve.entrypoint. Patch coming. I'll also run redwood-validate-weights to check archive format.

jonathan: When you patch, can you also add a compatibility tag under serve.compatibility so Dedicated routing picks the right kernel? Example: "serve.compatibility": ["runners/v2", "quantized:8bit"]

sachin: One more tokenizer thing — ensure special_tokens includes <pad> and <eos>. SentencePiece models sometimes omit <pad>. If missing, runtime will auto-insert but it's better to be explicit: 

```json
"tokenizer": {
  "type": "sentencepiece",
  "added_tokens": ["<id0>","<id1>"],
  "special_tokens": {"pad":"<pad>","eos":"<eos>"}
}
```

maria: Pushed a local branch and ran the quick fixes: 

```bash
git checkout -b model/mistral-v1-config-fix
jq '.tokenizer.added_tokens |= (if type=="string" then split(",") else . end) | .quantize_bits=8 | ."serve.entrypoint"="runners/mistral_v1:entrypoint" | ."serve.compatibility"=["runners/v2","quantized:8bit"]' config.json > config.fixed.json
# verify
./tools/schema-lint config.fixed.json || true
./tools/redwood-validate-weights s3://redwood-models/mistral/v1/weights.tar.gz
```

schema-lint-bot: schema-lint: config.fixed.json -> OK (warnings: special_tokens.pad missing -> recommended but not required)

deploy-bot: CI: model-tools unit tests passed for branch model/mistral-v1-config-fix. Integration smoke test queued (job 8672).

maria: Smoke serve succeeded locally: logs show "model initialized", "kv cache enabled", serving on 0.0.0.0:8080. I'll open the PR in a minute.

katie: LGTM — add PR link and tag @platform for Dedicated onboarding.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/497 — includes config normalization, quantize_bits=8, serve.entrypoint, compatibility tags, and tokenizer special_tokens add.

jonathan: Nice. Once CI finishes and smoke test passes on infra, we'll schedule a dedicated onboarding window. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
